title: KANTO >=1000 HIGH-IMPACT UNRESEARCHED PREFLIGHT 3
scope: Preflight only. The live pool was reconstructed from the 39 Kanto >=1,000 ledger records labelled inventory-unresearched, then cross-checked against every inventory record and production identity. Existing production, ADOPT, formal HOLD/DEFER/HARD-CASE/JUDGMENT, aliases/duplicates, RaiBoC, and 千葉県文化会館 were excluded. No seat transcription, source JSON, fingerprints, generated catalog/runtime, or production implementation is in scope.

policy.reason: This wave judges currentness, issuer-defined representative scope, and whether future implementation can independently validate a full numbered configuration; it performs no transcription.
policy.currentness: Before any seating evidence, every opened candidate was screened with current first-party material for operation, closure, renovation, reconstruction, cessation, reopening, and facility-versus-space scope. An announced long closure/cessation within twelve months is a HOLD in principle; no exception is inferred.
policy.productionSafety: Capacity is never seat evidence. No capacity fitting, invented IDs, geometry completion, configuration mixing, or third-party seat-map gap filling is permitted.
policy.raiboc: RaiBoC was not opened or re-researched. Its current ledger and inventory wording already says issuer evidence is complete, the repository transcription is invalid, and separately authorized transcription remediation is required; no metadata normalization was necessary.

excludedBeforeRanking.reason: The ledger still carries inventory-unresearched, but the canonical inventory record is already researchStatus blocked with a concrete official-source reachability blocker. It was excluded as existing formal work and not normalized/re-audited in this wave.

candidatePool.identityChecks: All four opened IDs have venueSourceId null, no aliases, and no matching production source name/alias/facility-space identity. RaiBoC and 千葉県文化会館 were independently excluded by their non-pool ledger statuses.

method: Prioritized current live/concert/theatre/ticketed-event use, then purpose-built theatre/hall fit, current issuer-numbered-chart prospect, representative-configuration clarity, and metropolitan/capacity relevance.
Applied a yield penalty to arenas, stadiums, exhibition halls, standing-first rooms, or facilities with issuer-declared movable/event-dependent layouts; capacity alone never controlled rank.
The non-opened records below are selection signals only and retain their existing ledger statuses.

researched.identity: KAAT神奈川芸術劇場〔ホール〕 / 神奈川県横浜市 / theatre
researched.currentOperationalStatus: ACTIVE. Current issuer facility material presents the theatre as its urban performing-arts hall and current download material; no facility-wide or hall-specific closure, renovation, reconstruction, cessation, or reopening notice within twelve months was found.
researched.officialCapacity: The current facility page describes maximum approximately 1,200 seats. The issuer-defined 基準勾配 PDF states 1,187 seats, excluding seated-standing, standing, and wheelchair positions.
researched.configuration: Dedicated variable theatre. The issuer explicitly names 基準勾配 as the standard pattern; acute-gradient, flat-floor, hanamichi and pit possibilities are separate modes and are not mixed into this candidate scope.
researched.currentOfficialSeatChart: YES — current facility/download pages link the one-page 基準勾配 PDF, whose rendered chart visibly contains individually printed numbered seat cells and floor labels.
researched.semantics: The PDF explicitly excludes seated-standing, standing, and wheelchair positions from 1,187. It shows wheelchair locations but does not establish a replacement relation; PA and side-balcony obstructed-seat treatment must be read directly later.

issuerChecksumStructure.otherIssuerDefinedSubtotals: Standing/seated-standing/wheelchair are expressly outside the standard subtotal; no inferred count is recorded.

researched.machineStructuralCountFeasibility: possible — the current vector PDF visibly has discrete numbered seat cells and row/bar structure. PDF text extraction already exposes floor/subtotal labels; a later independent machine pass can use vector text/cell geometry and a rendered connected-component count, without doing either full count here.
researched.implementationReadyRationale: A coherent issuer-named standard configuration, complete printed identifiers, and three issuer floor checksums exist. Configuration alternatives are disclosed rather than inferred.

implementationVerificationPlan.issuerChecksumStructure: Require 1F 778 / 2F 189 / 3F 220 = 1,187 reconciliation; preserve issuer-excluded standing, seated-standing and wheelchair semantics rather than fitting IDs.
implementationVerificationPlan.independentStructuralCheck: Use a machine-expanded range count plus independent PDF vector/text seat-cell analysis and rendered discrete-glyph/component count; investigate any mismatch by returning to the chart.
mandatoryFutureGate: machine verification of expanded range set
mapped per-floor subtotal equals issuer subtotal or has an issuer-explained difference
stop production and return to the chart on any mismatch

researched.identity: LaLa arena TOKYO-BAY / 千葉県船橋市 / arena
researched.currentOperationalStatus: ACTIVE. The current issuer event calendar lists ticketed entertainment and sports through 2027; no closure, renovation, reconstruction, cessation, or reopening notice within twelve months was found.
researched.officialCapacity: 11,000 is the inventory discovery value; the current issuer seat page is not used as a single fixed-configuration capacity declaration.
researched.configuration: Arena. The issuer distinguishes fixed and movable seating, and its FAQ says the placement changes by event.
researched.currentOfficialSeatChart: YES, but not a complete issuer-defined representative configuration: the current page gives floor/section diagrams and range callouts while the issuer says actual placement is event-specific.
researched.semantics: Movable seating may be used by event. The issuer says wheelchair-seat availability and location also vary by event. No fixed-only condition, full fixed-seat subtotal, or wheelchair replacement relation is published.

issuerChecksumStructure.grand: No current issuer-defined complete representative grand total found
issuerChecksumStructure.otherIssuerDefinedSubtotals: Fixed/movable labels and range callouts exist, but not an issuer-defined whole-configuration checksum.

researched.machineStructuralCountFeasibility: partially possible — the issuer web diagrams contain raster section/row structure and range callouts, so components can be studied, but a machine count cannot turn event-dependent material into an issuer-defined configuration.
researched.exactBlocker: Current issuer material expressly makes seating placement and wheelchair positions event-dependent; combining the displayed diagrams or inventing a fixed-only set would violate configuration policy.
researched.reopenCondition: Issuer publishes a current complete numbered representative event configuration, or an explicit fixed-only condition with the full identifier set and accessibility semantics.

implementationSafetyCarryForward: The RaiBoC/Chiba audit demonstrated that matching human visual two-pass transcriptions can reproduce the same systematic error. Human-two-pass MATCH is therefore necessary but not sufficient for any future production promotion: use this report's mandatory issuer-subtotal and independent machine structural checksum gates, and halt production on mismatch. This report records the future requirement only; it does not amend docs/VENUE_DATA_GUIDE.md.
